scope: Selected candidate environment reports, native audit environment and compiler records, pipeline metadata and process/resource reports, kernel timing metadata, and sanitizer commands/compiler logs
review: Read the retained metadata fields and process reports; additionally scanned selected environment/process records for credential assignment patterns without printing any matching values.
retained_context: Hardware model, CPU, memory, operating system and load statistics
Compiler versions, commands, source and executable hashes
Absolute build and fixture paths on the original run host
This repository's changed-file names and immutable revision identifiers
Process resource statistics and generated audio fixture identities
not_collected: Browser state, user documents, credentials or unrelated application content
note: Source snapshots and generated fixture files are retained for reproducibility. This review does not claim to scan arbitrary user storage.
